raw_responses.English:
This pie chart visually represents the proportional distribution of data across three distinct years: 2017, 2018, and 2019, with each year assigned a separate colored slice. The chart contains three slices: the largest, colored blue, corresponds to 2019 and accounts for 46.0% (value 46); the orange slice for 2018 represents 33.0% (value 33); and the green slice for 2017 constitutes 21.0% (value 21). Each slice is labeled with its year, percentage, and raw value in parentheses, positioned directly within the slice. The slices are arranged clockwise starting from the top with 2019, followed by 2017, then 2018, and no legend is present since labels are embedded. The chart does not feature exploded slices or other visual emphasis techniques, and the segments appear ordered by decreasing size from 2019 to 2017 to 2018.

DESCRIPTION: This pie chart displays the proportional distribution across three years: 2019 (blue, 46.0%, value 46), 2018 (orange, 33.0%, value 33), and 2017 (green, 21.0%, value 21), with each slice labeled internally with year, percentage, and raw value; no legend is used, and slices are arranged clockwise from the top without visual emphasis or explosion, appearing ordered by descending size.
raw_responses.German:
This pie chart visually represents the proportional distribution of data across three distinct years: 2017, 2018, and 2019. The chart is divided into three segments, each corresponding to one year and labeled with both a percentage and an absolute value in parentheses. The largest segment, colored blue, represents the year 2019 and accounts for 46.0% of the total (value 46). The orange segment, labeled 2018, constitutes 33.0% (value 33), while the green segment for 2017 makes up 21.0% (value 21). Each segment’s label is placed within the slice, displaying both the percentage and the numerical value, and the segments are arranged in clockwise order starting from the top with 2019, followed by 2018 and then 2017. There is no separate legend; the year labels and color coding are directly integrated into the chart. The segments are not visually exploded or emphasized beyond their proportional size.

DESCRIPTION: This pie chart displays the proportional distribution across three years: 2019 (blue, 46.0%, value 46), 2018 (orange, 33.0%, value 33), and 2017 (green, 21.0%, value 21), with labels placed directly within each segment showing both percentage and absolute value, arranged clockwise starting from the top with 2019, and no separate legend or visual emphasis beyond proportional sizing.
